description:
A Windows uninstaller that finds and quarantines what programs leave behind.

Prune runs a program's own uninstaller, then finds the leftover files, registry keys and scheduled tasks and moves them to a Quarantine you can restore from. It also has a disk map, a Deep Clean with measured cleaner rules, a startup manager and SSD health. No telemetry, everything runs locally.
Changed
- The theme choice is also saved in settings.json. The theme you pick is kept with your other settings, so it is part of the same file as everything else instead of living only in the window's own storage.

Fixed
- Prune keeps working when another program has its port. The window always called 127.0.0.1:3101, so when another local server was already listening there, Prune talked to that server instead of its own and showed errors such as "Couldn't load programs: Unauthorized". Prune now uses a free port when 3101 is taken, and checks it is talking to its own background service before loading anything; if something else answers, it says so plainly instead of showing that program's replies.

Security
- Electron 44.11.5, which carries upstream's certificate mitigation and its permission-attribution fixes.
- Patched development tooling (undici, fast-uri, vite, vitest, source-map-js, electron-builder) and the backend's qs override raised to 6.17.1. None of it ships inside the installed app.
